notes.title: High scores and Episode 2!
notes.notes:
Welcome back Wayfarer!

Just a quick announcement.

Many of you have played and completed Blind Quest - The Enchanted Castle. To complete the game 20.000 Experience Points are enough. So we were incredibly excited to see that some of you wanted to go further and hit big numbers. At the moment the best hero is .J23 with a high score of 193.715 Mercenary Points!
 
We also have exciting news! We are working on the next episode: BLIND QUEST - THE FROST DEMON of which you can enjoy the trailer soon!
 
Stay tuned!
 
SPREAD THE WORD!
 
- Audiogame Association

notes.title: The Demon: a new adventure
notes.notes:
Hi all!

We hope you are all having fun with [i]Blind Quest: The Enchanted Castle[/i].

We wanted to let you know that you can find another audiogame produced by us here on Steam: [i]The Demon - Nicolas Eymerich Inquisitor Audiogame[/i].

An exciting adventure game in 8 different scenarios: haunted woods, caves invaded by monstrous creatures, crypts full of secrets, to the Final Clash with the Evil One.

An innovative audio-navigational system to explore maps in the most remote corners.
From the village of Calcares to the dungeons of the Abbey.

Combat mechanics in which you will control both Eymerich and Jacinto Corona.

You will use the strength, the spirit, and the power of the Faith.
Dialogues in which to discover precious clues or the demonstration of the Lie of the Heresy.
Enigmas to solve with the ingenuity of divine intuition.
